name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately reflects the behavior (scan battle map for the first tile whose attributes match a tag). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Scan the battle map for the first event-type-1 tile carrying a given tag and return its (x,y).
logic_summary: Row-major double loop (y outer 0..map_height-1, x inner 0..map_width-1). For each tile calls fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos(x, y, &tile_buf) which fills an 8-byte buffer: [+2] = 5-bit terrain_class (used here as the event-tile tag), [+4] = attribute-flags byte 0. A tile matches when (attr_flags & 0x60) == 0x20 (event tile type 1) AND terrain_class == target_tag. On the first match it writes out_pos[0]=x and out_pos[1]=y as bytes and returns 0; if the whole map is scanned with no match it returns -1 (0xFFFFFFFF).

params.name: target_tag
params.semantics: The tag matched against each tile's terrain_class field (tile_buf+2). Sole caller (fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher AI class 5) passes the char's AI event-target id (runtime_char.pAi_target_and_DX_block[0]), which doubles as the index into the tile-event data table.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value's role (a tag/id matched against tile attributes); no address residue, not param_N.

params.name: out_pos
params.semantics: Pointer to a caller-supplied buffer; on a hit out_pos[0] receives the tile x and out_pos[1] the tile y, each written as a single byte.
params.reason: Accurately names the output position pointer; no address residue, not param_N.

returns.semantics: 0 when a matching event tile is found (with its x,y written to out_pos as bytes); -1 (0xFFFFFFFF) when no tile on the map matches.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment called the matched field 'secondary_attr', which is imprecise: per the callee fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos, tile_buf+2 is the 5-bit terrain_class (tile meta byte & 0x1F) reused as the event-tile tag, while the 4-byte attribute record sits at +4..+7. The comment also omitted the exact filter value (attr_flags & 0x60)==0x20 and the caller context (AI class 5 item pickup; target_tag = AI event-target id).
notes: Single caller confirmed via get_function_callers + get_xrefs_to: fd2_enemy_turn_action_dispatcher @ 00013a9f (call site 00013c59). tile_buf layout cross-checked against callee fd2_read_tile_attribute_at_pos @ 00012e38. Ghidra plate is detailed and behaviorally correct (filter value, usage, return values); it labels +2 as 'secondary_attr (= tag)' which is a minor field-naming imprecision but not a behavioral contradiction with the refined src comment, so per the 'consistency is enough / do not churn plate' rule it was left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none).
